# DoINeedAPediatrician.com

> A public pediatrician directory organized by location.

- Canonical site: https://doineedapediatrician.com
- Geographic coverage: Canada; availability varies by listed location.
- Directory: /directory
- Location browse pages: /[region]
- Listing pages: /directory/[listing-slug]
- Owner or claim access: /owner/[listing-slug]

## Reader guidance

Use the directory and location pages to discover pediatrician listings. Verify current listing details directly with the listed business. This file is a concise orientation aid for crawlers and AI readers; it does not replace the public pages.
